pages.text: After finishing the first 2 chapters of this Simulation. You can create the $(item)Glitch Infused$() armor set.$(br2)This will bestow the wearer with creative flight, among other benefits.

pages.title: Mekanism Upgrades
pages.text: Midway into this simulation you will unlock $(item)Mekanism$() machines. They are slow and powerhungry. Unless you give them a ton of upgrades that is.$(br2)Most $(item)Mekanism$() machines can fit 8 $(item)Speed Upgrades$() and 8 $(item)Energy Upgrades$().$(br2)Some machines get a massive cost multiplier for each speedupgrade. So tinker around with what fit each machine the best.

pages.title: Energy Storage
pages.text: $(item)Induction Casing$() is the foundation to making the $(item)Induction Matrix$() multiblock. The required materials unlock late in this simulation.$(br2)We recommend this multiblock for your lategame energy-storage needs.

pages.title: Energy Storage
pages.text: Each provider placed in the multiblock increases how much $(item)RF per tick$() the multiblock is capable of transferring.

pages.title: Energy Storage
pages.text: Each cell placed in the multiblock increases how many RF units the multiblock is capable of storing.
